runner_guard.rows: decode and prefill rows (kind decode|prefill; not streams4)

spec_acceptance.label: speculative decoding, drafted tokens accepted
spec_acceptance.note: a ratio of acceptance rates; not in the plan's calibration, keeps the flat band it always had

band_note: Per-row bands for A/B verdicts (same-runner, ABBA): half-width of the interval around ratio 1.0 inside which a row PASSes. Calibrated from the 63 phase-3 A/B files (spread within one side, p50/p90): prefill_8k/16k/32k 0.6/2.6, 0.4/1.4, 0.3/0.9 %; prefill_1k/2k 1.3/5.0, 0.8/3.5 %; decode, decode_32k 1.6/9.2, 1.5/6.8 %; decode_2k, streams4 4.0/10.0, 1.8/8.4 %. reject: the T1 (2 sessions per side) ratio below which a change is rejected. A/A check (below, `band_calibration_aa`): the plan values were then replayed on true A/A pairs only; decode is widened to 3.5 %.
tie_band_note: Card outcome of a row against the better llama.cpp backend (rule 7): win > +3 %, tie within +-3 %, loss < -3 %. Flat on purpose: a card prints the band it was measured with and must not change when A/B bands do.
statistic: median over sessions of each session's median sample (rule 5), Loom and llama.cpp alike

sessions.streams4: the median of its c4_steady.py runs (a session's runs, then the median over sessions)

sequential.note: T1: start at 2+2 sessions; when a ratio falls within 2 points of its reject threshold extend to 6+6

bimodal_note: two decode modes ~10 % apart on both packages; compare sessions within a mode, never a silent pass when the slow mode's frequency moves

roofline.note: roofline.py: a measured row within this fraction of its ceiling is at the ceiling (no headroom to chase)

draft_tuning.note: draft/tune.py and llama_spec_tune.py: a drafter is used when the single-stream rate gains >= min_gain and no row is slower than no_loss x depth 0 (development loop, not a card number)

gates.note: gates.sh LEVEL; the gate names are the card's gate rows (card_lib.gate_applies decides which apply to a package)

dev.use: after each kept change in optimize / improve

quick.use: nightly; once before a new port's first card

full.use: the default; the final build, once

baselines.note: llama.cpp builds every Loom-vs-llama.cpp comparison on that device uses (one pinned build per backend; its stored rows are reused across jobs while the build and GGUF are unchanged, methodology rule 15)

radeon-rx7900xtx.none: no runner: no llama.cpp build is chosen until a DevLab runner is registered (device.json runner.labels); then add rocm and vulkan builds here

radeon-rx9070xt.none: no runner: no llama.cpp build is chosen until a DevLab runner is registered (device.json runner.labels); then add rocm and vulkan builds here

gfx1150.none: no runner: no llama.cpp build is chosen until a DevLab runner is registered (device.json runner.labels); then add rocm and vulkan builds here

ratchet.rule: promote a (model, GPU) package when every row >= baseline - band, gates pass, and greedy text matches or is a near-tie
ratchet.improvements: reach a card only after 2 confirming runs
ratchet.confirming_runs_note: the 2 runs may be submitted together as concurrent replicas (ab_jobs.py --replicas 2: first = replica 1, confirming = replica 2) on different runners; promote_check.py records the runner names, and two runs on one runner are two session sets of one machine (said so, still two runs)

band_calibration_aa.method: A/B results of the Strix phase-3 campaign (63 files, /lt/r9700stg/eng/*/ab) whose gfx11 programs were byte-identical between the published (loom-fun) and the staging package (fleet/loomtext.py view, gfx11); the old/new difference there is only runner and session noise. Per row: share of A/A |ratio-1| above the plan band; if above 5 %, band = max(plan, p95 of A/A |ratio-1|, rounded up to 0.5 %).

pairs.population: 22 pairs excluding Qwen2.5-0.5B and Qwen3-0.6B (bimodal models are judged mode-aware, see bimodal_models; their two modes sit ~10 % apart so no flat band applies)

band_calibration_aa.including_bimodal: with the two bimodal models in (26 pairs) decode exceeds 19 % (p95 3.9 %) and streams4 11.5 % (p95 9.8 %): bimodal-mode flips, not row noise; handled by the mode-aware rule, not a wider band.
